description: Implement the caissier UI and update the serveur view. Depends on FEAT-001 (UserRole.caissier must exist). Covers: (1) refactoring OrderActions to be role-aware, (2) removing PENDING from ServeurDashboard, (3) creating the CaissierDashboard page, (4) updating useOrders hook to include caissier in the status-based query path.
steps: 1. src/components/serveur/OrderActions.tsx — Add 'role?: "serveur" | "caissier"' to OrderActionsProps (default 'serveur'). Restructure the JSX: when role === 'caissier', render VALIDER + REJETER buttons only for PENDING orders (extract the existing PENDING block). When role === 'serveur' (default), render SERVI for READY, PAYÉ for SERVED, receipt view for PAID — do NOT render PENDING buttons. The reject modal and receipt modal remain unchanged and are shared between both roles.

2. src/pages/serveur/ServeurDashboard.tsx — (a) Remove OrderStatus.PENDING from WAITER_STATUSES (new array: [VALIDATED, IN_PREPARATION, READY, SERVED]). (b) Remove OrderStatus.PENDING from GROUP_ORDER. (c) Pass role='serveur' to <OrderActions> inside PendingAwareOrderRow. (d) Remove the isPending prop from PendingAwareOrderRow and the ring/pulse class (no PENDING cards here anymore). (e) Remove the knownPendingIds sound-notification useEffect block — the caissier dashboard will own this.

3. src/hooks/useOrders.ts — In the useEffect condition 'if (role === "cuisine" || role === "serveur") ...', extend it to also match 'caissier': change to 'if (["cuisine", "serveur", "caissier"].includes(role) && statuses && statuses.length > 0)'. This routes CaissierDashboard's useOrders call to the getOrdersByStatus path (querying only PENDING).

4. src/pages/caissier/CaissierDashboard.tsx — Create this file from scratch following the ServeurDashboard.tsx pattern: (a) Same header: gradient 'from-white to-[#FFF8F0]', app name, t('caissier.dashboard') label, user name, clock, LanguageSwitcher, logout button. (b) No left-panel table list — the caissier sees all PENDING orders, grouped by tableId for clarity. (c) useOrders called with { role: UserRole.caissier, statuses: [OrderStatus.PENDING] }. (d) Sound notification: same knownPendingIds useRef + hasInteracted useRef pattern from ServeurDashboard — play /notification.mp3 on new PENDING arrivals. (e) Group orders by tableId: build a Map, display each group under a 'Table N°X' heading. (f) Each order: + . (g) Animate with framer-motion: same motion.div with y: -24 → 0 entrance. (h) Empty state:

{t('caissier.no_pending')}

. (i) Loading state: .

useOrders hook returns status-filtered orders when called with role='caissier' and a statuses array
